faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support-III position is 05-09-2026. Ensure all your documents and the application are submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Graduate degree in Public Health, Clinical Psychology, Social Work, Sociology, or Psychology with three years of post-qualification experience, or a Post-Graduate degree in these fields.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Technical Support-III position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this role is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the prevailing government rules and regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support-III role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 28,000, along with an additional 30% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support-III post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Technical Support-III position in the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Delhi.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support-III recruitment must be submitted online through the official website or the provided application link.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Technical Support-III position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Application Screening, followed by Shortlisting of candidates, and finally an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the selected candidate be posted?
faq.answer: The job location for this position is Delhi, specifically New Delhi / Ghaziabad. Candidates should be prepared to work in these areas.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Delhi apply for this position?
faq.answer: While the notification mentions applications from eligible candidates in Delhi, it is advisable to check the official notification for any specific residency requirements or eligibility for candidates from other states.
